question:
Find the part of the sentence that contains an error:

It was not until the second report (1)/ was leaked to the press (2)/ did the ministry issue (3)/ a formal clarification. (4)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The error in the sentence lies in part **(3)**.
 
• The use of "**did the ministry issue**" is incorrect in this context.
 
• The sentence is a declarative sentence, not an interrogative one, so "**did**" should not be used here.
